messages:
Nadia: heads-up — tiny-infer latency SLOs spiking in us-west1c since 05:40. lots of 1GPU pods Pending then `Preempted`.
Ethan: any scheduler traces?
Nadia: events show `FailedAttach` -> `Preempted`. warmpool count jumped down from 130 -> 22 in ~12m. network attach timeouts for several racks.
Maya: this came after we turned on tenant-aware affinity (pack by tenant to improve cache locality). seems one tenants long-seq batch jobs pinned NVLink racks, starving warmpools for tiny replicas.
infra-bot: ALERT: warmpool depletion us-west1c at 8488001450. affected pods: 67 small-GPU; preemptions: 103.
Ethan: two levers: 1) revert tenant-affinity (disruptive), 2) fast-path: annotate tiny pods so scheduler treats them as `latency:high` and prefers warmpool nodes, plus bump warmpool min.
Maya: I can push an admission mutator to add `inference.tier=latency` to pods that match `resources.limits.gpu==1 && metadata.annotations.seq_len < 512`. quick patch below:\n
```
# mutator pseudo
if pod.gpu == 1 and pod.seq_len < 512:
  pod.labels['inference.tier']='latency'
```

Nadia: infra, can you bump warmpool while Marie reverts? (we prefer not to revert immediately)
Ethan: bumping warmpool: `kubectl -n infra patch warmpool us-west1c -p '{"spec":{"minSize":160}}'` — applied.
infra-bot: ACTION: warmpool.minSize updated at 8488001488. mutator rollout started at 8488001495.
Maya: mutator live. scheduler now sees `inference.tier=latency` and avoids packing those onto NVLink-hot racks.
Nadia: early telemetry: pending queue halved, preemptions trending down. a few racks still show conntrack backlog — attach times ~3x for pods scheduled there.
Ethan: queuing/conntrack is a secondary issue — network team: can we drain/rehab top-of-rack for r5-6?
SRE Oncall: immediate follow-ups: 1) add `tenant_seq_skew` metric, 2) add `inference.tier` placement hint to scheduler (long-term), 3) make tenant-affinity a tunable with spill threshold (avoid >60% long-seq on same rack).
Maya: PR for spill-threshold in packer: github.com/redwood/packers/pull/1198. also opening ticket with perf traces.
infra-bot: RESOLVED: warmpool recovered at 8488001552.
Nadia: thanks everyone. will file a short postmortem and add a runbook step: if warmpool < 30% baseline, temporarily set minSize to baseline+25% and deploy latency mutator. :thumbsup:
